blocks.text: FedPoint reimburses up to **$400 a year** for a financial plan, a will or a trust.

items.label: Financial plan
items.text: must come from a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) or Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC).

items.label: Will or trust
items.text: must be drafted by an estate planning attorney.

items.label: To claim
items.text: submit the reimbursement form with a paid receipt in your name.

items.label: Tax
items.text: the reimbursement is taxable and appears on your W-2.
